propositions: inbound_probe.py holds Jira-specific REST probe code (URL shape, basic-auth GET, status-name classification, JIRA_* env resolution) inside backend-neutral core.
Jira probe mechanics should relocate to adapters/jira/probe.py while neutral vocabulary (ProbeBranch, ProbeResult, ProbeConfigError) remains at package root.
A runtime_checkable SupportsAbsenceProbe capability protocol with probe_remote should be added in _backend.py and implemented by JiraBackend.
run_differs must route the probe only through the SupportsAbsenceProbe capability, degrading to UNREACHABLE when the backend lacks it.
The AST neutrality gate should assert zero adapters.jira imports in inbound_probe.py.
Jira probe classification behavior must remain byte-identical across all branches after the split.
